hints.content:
The greatest common factor of $44k^5$, $-66k^4$, and $77k^3$ is $11k^3$.

[[☃ explanation 2]]

Now we need to factor $11k^3$ out of $44k^5-66k^4+77k^3$.

options.explanation:
We find the prime factors of each term:

$\begin{align}
44k^5&=(2)(2)\blueD{(11)}\goldD{(k)(k)(k)}(k)(k)
\\\\
-66k^4&=(-1)(2)(3)\blueD{(11)}\goldD{(k)(k)(k)}(k)
\\\\
77k^3&=(7)\blueD{(11)}\goldD{(k)(k)(k)}
\end{align}$

The greatest common factor is the product of all the shared parts:

$\blueD{(11)}\goldD{(k)(k)(k)}=11k^3$
